assets.title: Plaster 001
assets.processing: Derived work (allowed under CC0): resized to 512x512 for the repo and 1024x1024 for local use (not shipped). albedo.jpg: Color map decoded sRGB -> linear, luminance Y = 0.2126R + 0.7152G + 0.0722B divided by its mean, multiplied by a gain of 0.800 (0.8 per brief; raised only where the [0,1] clamp would pull the mean below 0.8) and clamped, so the mean linear value is 0.8 (measured 0.800 after JPEG, 0.0% of pixels at the clamp); re-encoded to sRGB as a 3-channel grey JPEG, quality 84; the 512 px version is a 2x2 area average taken in linear light. nr.jpg: NormalGL (OpenGL, +Y up) averaged 2x2 and renormalised at the output size, packed as R = normal.x, G = normal.y (n*0.5+0.5) with B = Roughness (2x2 average), JPEG quality 90, 4:4:4 chroma. Only the Color, NormalGL and Roughness maps (plus NormalDX for a convention check) were read; the other files in the zip were not used.
